ALB.desc: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets and virtual appliances in one or more Availability Zones (AZs).

API Gateway.desc: Amazon API Gateway helps you build HTTP, REST, and WebSocket APIs with a fully managed service that makes it easy to create, publish, maintain, manage, monitor, and secure APIs.

Amplify.desc: Accelerate your full-stack web and mobile app development with AWS Amplify. Easy to start, easy to scale. No cloud expertise needed.

App Mesh.desc: AWS App Mesh is an application networking service mesh that lets you more easily monitor and control communications across services.

App Runner.desc: AWS App Runner helps you deploy and scale from your source code or container image to a secure web application on AWS.

AppSync.desc: Accelerate application development with 100% serverless GraphQL and Pub/Sub APIs. Get 250,000 API requests free per month for 12 months.

Athena.desc: Amazon Athena is a serverless, interactive analytics service that provides a simplified and flexible way to analyze petabytes of data where it lives.

Aurora.desc: Amazon Aurora is a global-scale relational database service built for the cloud with full MySQL and PostgreSQL compatibility.

Auto Scaling.desc: Learn how AWS Auto Scaling monitors your applications and automatically adjusts capacity to maintain steady, predictable performance at the lowest possible cost.

Backup.desc: AWS Backup lets you centrally manage and automate backups across AWS services and third-party applications.

Bedrock.desc: Amazon Bedrock: The platform for building generative AI applications and agents at production scale

Billing.desc: Learn how AWS pay-as-you approach to pricing works, and calculate your solution. With AWS you pay only for the individual services you need, for as long as you use them, and without requiring long-term contracts or complex licensing.

CDK.desc: AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) is an open-source software development framework used to model and provision your cloud application resources with familiar programming languages.

CloudFormation.desc: AWS CloudFormation is an infrastructure as code (IaC) service that allows you to easily model, provision, and manage AWS and third-party resources.

CloudFront.desc: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service that helps you distribute your static and dynamic content quickly and reliably with high speed performance, security, and developer ease-of-use.

CloudTrail.desc: AWS CloudTrail enables governance, compliance, operational auditing, and risk auditing of your AWS account.

CloudWatch.desc: Amazon CloudWatch is a monitoring service built for DevOps engineers, developers, site reliability engineers (SREs), IT managers, and product owners.

CloudWatch Logs.desc: Amazon CloudWatch is a monitoring service built for DevOps engineers, developers, site reliability engineers (SREs), IT managers, and product owners.

CodeCommit.desc: AWS CodeCommit is a managed source control repository that makes it easier for teams to securely collaborate on code with contributions encrypted in transit and at rest.

CodeDeploy.desc: AWS CodeDeploy makes it easier for you to rapidly release new features, avoid downtime during application deployment, and handle the complexity of updating your applications.

CodePipeline.desc: AWS CodePipeline automates the build, test, and deploy phases of your release process each time a code change occurs.

Config.desc: AWS Config is a config tool that helps you assess, audit, and evaluate the configurations and relationships of your resources.

Connect.desc: Amazon Connect Customer is an easy-to-use omnichannel cloud contact center service offering superior, low-cost customer service using machine learning (ML), interactive voice response (IVR), and call center routing.

Control Tower.desc: AWS Control Tower provides a single location to set up a well-architected, multi-account environment to govern your AWS workloads with rules for security, operations, and compliance.

Cost Explorer.desc: AWS Cost Explorer has an easy-to-use interface that lets you visualize, understand, and manage your AWS cloud costs and usage over time.

Data Pipeline.desc: AWS Glue is a serverless data integration service that makes it easy to discover, prepare, integrate, and modernize the extract, transform, and load (ETL) process.

Direct Connect.desc: AWS Direct Connect is a cloud service that links your network directly to AWS to deliver consistent, low-latency performance.

DynamoDB.desc: Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed, serverless, key-value NoSQL database that runs high-performance applications at any scale, with built-in security, continuous backups, and automated multi-region replication.

EBS.desc: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) is an easy to use, high-performance cloud Storage Area Network (SAN).

EC2.desc: Amazon EC2 provides secure, resizable compute in the cloud, offering the broadest choice of processor, storage, networking, OS, and purchase model.

ECR.desc: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) is a fully managed Docker container registry that makes it easy to store, share, and deploy container images.

ECS.desc: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) provides a fully managed container service solution that’s easy to use, scalable, secure, and reliable.

EFS.desc: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) provides a simple, scalable fully managed elastic NFS file system for AWS compute instances.

EKS.desc: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) is a managed service and certified Kubernetes conformant to run Kubernetes on AWS and on-premises.

EMR.desc: Amazon EMR is a cloud big data platform for running large-scale distributed data processing jobs, interactive SQL queries, and machine learning applications using open-source analytics frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Hive, and Presto.

ElastiCache.desc: Amazon ElastiCache is a serverless, fully managed caching service delivering microsecond latency performance with full Valkey-, Memcached-, and Redis OSS-compatibility.

Elastic Beanstalk.desc: AWS Elastic Beanstalk helps you deploy and manage web applications with capacity provisioning, app health monitoring, and more.

Elastic Load Balancing.desc: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets and virtual appliances in one or more Availability Zones (AZs).

EventBridge.desc: Amazon EventBridge is a serverless event bus that ingests data from your own apps, SaaS apps, and AWS services and routes that data to targets.

Fargate.desc: AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers that works with both Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes (EKS).

Firehose.desc: Create a streaming data pipeline for real-time ingest (streaming ETL) into data lakes and analytics tools with Amazon Data Firehose.

Glacier.desc: Long-term, secure, durable Amazon S3 object storage classes for data archiving, starting at $1 per terabyte per month.

Global Accelerator.desc: AWS Global Accelerator is a networking service that simplifies traffic management and improves performance by up to 60%.

Glue.desc: AWS Glue is a serverless data integration service that makes it easy to discover, prepare, integrate, and modernize the extract, transform, and load (ETL) process.

Graviton.desc: AWS Graviton processors deliver the best price performance for your cloud workloads, optimized for a range of general-purpose, compute, memory, and storage-intensive workloads.

GuardDuty.desc: Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that monitors for malicious activity and anomalous behavior to protect AWS accounts, workloads, and data.

IAM.desc: Access management for AWS services and resources. Manage fine-grained permissions and analyze access to refine permissions.

IAM Identity Center.desc: IAM Identity Center helps you securely create, or connect, your workforce identities and manage their access centrally across AWS accounts and applications.

Internet Gateway.desc: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is a service that lets you launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network that you define.

KMS.desc: Learn how AWS Key Management Service (KMS) provides you with logs of key usage to help you meet your regulatory and compliance needs.

Kafka.desc: Amazon MSK is a fully managed, secure, and highly available Apache Kafka service that makes it easy to ingest and process streaming data in real time at a low cost.

Keyspaces.desc: Learn more about Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra), a scalable, highly available, and managed Apache Cassandra compatible database service.

Kinesis.desc: Collect streaming data, create a real-time data pipeline, and analyze real-time video and data streams, log analytics, event analytics, and IoT analytics.

Lambda.desc: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service for running code without having to provision or manage servers. You pay only for the compute time you consume.

MemoryDB.desc: Amazon MemoryDB is a Valkey- and Redis OSS-compatible, durable, in-memory database service that delivers ultra-fast performance.

NAT Gateway.desc: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is a service that lets you launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network that you define.

NLB.desc: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets and virtual appliances in one or more Availability Zones (AZs).

Neptune.desc: Amazon Neptune is a fast, fully managed database service powering graph use cases such as identity graphs, knowledge graphs, and fraud detection.

Network Firewall.desc: AWS Network firewall helps you define firewall rules that provide fine-grained control over network traffic and deploy network firewall security across your VPCs

OpenSearch.desc: Amazon OpenSearch Service is a managed retrieval engine for AI and search at petabyte scale. Power RAG, semantic search, and observability with serverless scaling.

Organizations.desc: AWS Organizations enables centralized cloud account management as you grow and scale your AWS resources.

PCS.desc: AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) makes it easy to setup and manage high performance computing (HPC) clusters, and build scientific and engineering models at virtually any scale on AWS.

PrivateLink.desc: AWS PrivateLink provides private connectivity between VPCs, AWS services, and on-premises applications securely on AWS.

Prometheus.desc: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is a monitoring and alerting service that makes it easier to monitor containerized applications and infrastructure securely, at scale.

QuickSight.desc: AI-powered BI that transforms data into strategic insights for everyone through unified intelligence, actionable analytics, and democratized data access.

RAM.desc: AWS Resource Access Manager helps you securely share your AWS resources with other AWS accounts.

RDS.desc: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) is a fully managed, open source cloud database service that allows you to easily operate and scale your relational database of choice, including Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL.

Redshift.desc: Amazon Redshift is a fast, fully managed cloud data warehouse that makes it simple and cost-effective to analyze all your data.

Relational Database.desc: Learn about the important aspects of relational databases and review the relational database engines available on Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS.

Resilience Hub.desc: AWS Resilience Hub helps define, validate, and track the resilience of your applications on AWS from a single place.

Route 53.desc: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable cloud domain name system (DNS) service. Enables to customize DNS routing policies to reduce latency.

S3.desc: Amazon S3 is cloud object storage with industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. S3 is ideal for data lakes, mobile applications, backup and restore, archival, IoT devices, ML, AI, and analytics.

SES.desc: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) is a cost-effective, flexible, and scalable email service provider that allows developers to send email from within any application.

SNS.desc: Amazon SNS is a managed messaging service for communication, allowing messaging between decoupled microservices applications or directly to users with SMS texts, mobile push, and email.

SQS.desc: Amazon SQS fully managed message queuing makes it easy to decouple and scale microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications.

SSM.desc: AWS Systems Manager is a secure end-to-end management solution for resources on AWS and in multicloud and hybrid environments.

SageMaker.desc: The next generation of Amazon SageMaker is the center for all your data, analytics, and AI

Savings Plans.desc: Savings Plans is a flexible pricing model that provides up to 72% savings on your AWS usage compared to On-Demand prices.

Secrets Manager.desc: AWS Secrets Manager allows you to rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets through their lifecycle.

Security Hub.desc: AWS Security Hub prioritizes your critical security issues and helps you respond at scale to protect your environment. It simplifies and unifies security operations through centralized management. It detects critical issues by correlating and enriching signals into actionable insights, enabling a streamlined response.

Service Catalog.desc: AWS Service Catalog helps you create and manage IaC templates approved for use on AWS so anyone can discover approved, self-service cloud resources.

Shield.desc: AWS Shield protects networks and applications by analyzing network security configurations and providing managed DDoS protection

Single Sign-On.desc: IAM Identity Center helps you securely create, or connect, your workforce identities and manage their access centrally across AWS accounts and applications.

Spot.desc: Amazon EC2 Spot Instances are unused compute capacity in the AWS cloud available to you at steep discounts compared to On-Demand prices.

Step Functions.desc: AWS Step Functions lets you orchestrate multiple AWS services into serverless workflows so that you can build and update applications quickly.

Systems Manager.desc: AWS Systems Manager is a secure end-to-end management solution for resources on AWS and in multicloud and hybrid environments.

Transit Gateway.desc: AWS Transit Gateway connects virtual private cloud and on-premises networks through a central hub. It acts as a highly scalable cloud router so you can easily add to your network.

VPC.desc: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is a service that lets you launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network that you define.

WAF.desc: AWS WAF is a managed cloud web application firewall (WAF) service that protects websites, APIs, and applications from bots, exploits, and layer 7 events. Deploy scalable, enterprise-grade WAF solutions with global protection.

Well-Architected.desc: The AWS Well-Architected Framework provides guidance to help developers build and deploy applications faster, lower risk, and make informed decisions following AWS best practices.

WorkSpaces.desc: Amazon WorkSpaces provides secure, managed virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) in the cloud. Deploy Windows and Linux desktops quickly with pay-as-you-go pricing, 99.9% uptime SLA, and seamless integration with your existing IT infrastructure. Start your free trial today.

X-Ray.desc: Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals provides application performance monitoring (APM), distributed tracing, and real-time observability to help teams optimize cloud apps, reduce latency, and improve reliability.

forecast.desc: Amazon Forecast is a fully managed time-series forecasting service that uses the same machine learning technology used at Amazon.com.
